title: Free producer build dir before verifier; resume retry from kept
summary: Fix two gaps for operators of Athena: after Athena's own checks pass, delete the job's target/produce before the verifier starts (kept if checks fail, for send-back); and make `athena retry` resume a job stopped for an environment cause after build from the kept candidate at the stopped stage, with no planner or producer run.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added; fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test must pass.
Criteria check the dir removal and the retry skipping planner/producer by test.
Both the disk use and the resume gap are fixed.
Criterion on the job finishing and retry not re-running.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: Athena operators get jobs that finish and retries that resume cheaply.
The existing timed-out-producer keep/resume path can be generalized to later stages.
No governance file changes are needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in crates/athena-core shows target/produce is absent after checks pass and before the verifier runs, and still present when checks fail (send-back). Run: cargo test
A test stops a job on low disk before the verifier, then runs retry and asserts only the verifier ran on the kept candidate, with zero planner and zero producer invocations. Run: cargo test

Retry resume logic in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs and reading.rs treats low disk, usage limit and interrupted process after the candidate is built as resumable at the stopped stage, using the same keep mechanism as a timed-out producer.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing both fixes.
Outcome check: a job that passes checks with 9.5 GB free no longer stops on disk for lack of target/produce space, and its retry does not re-plan or rebuild.

out_of_scope: Changing the 10 GB minimum free-disk threshold
departures: Higher cost and lower pass chance than reference: touches run pipeline and retry resume state, needing two integration-style tests.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time: avoids a failed verifier stop on low disk and a redo-work retry that re-plans and rebuilds for about $5.
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline (when build output is removed before verification) and how retry resumes a stopped job, which are costly to get wrong.
